Parse the HGNC Gene Nomenclature Files

Source: R/hgnc_parser.R
parseHGNC.Rd

Reads the HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee (HGNC) complete set (hgnc_complete_set.txt) and, optionally, the withdrawn entries (withdrawn.txt) and returns a dvobject with gene, gene name and withdrawn tables.

Usage

parseHGNC(
  complete_set_path,
  withdrawn_path = NULL,
  release = NULL,
  release_date = NULL,
  retrieved_at = NULL
)

Arguments

complete_set_path

Character. Path to hgnc_complete_set.txt.

withdrawn_path

Character or NULL. Path to withdrawn.txt. When NULL the withdrawn table is not built.

release

Character or NULL. Release label, e.g. "2026-10".

release_date

Date, "YYYY-MM-DD" or NULL. Release date.

retrieved_at

Date, "YYYY-MM-DD" or NULL. Date the files were downloaded.

Value

A dvobject with tibbles:

gene

One row per approved gene, keyed by hgnc_id, with the file's columns. Multi-valued cells keep the file's a|b text.

gene_name

One row per (hgnc_id, kind, name): each gene's approved symbol (kind "symbol") and name ("name"), and every alias and previous symbol and name ("alias_symbol", "prev_symbol", "alias_name", "prev_name"), split on | and trimmed. Empty values and exact duplicates are dropped; names that differ only in case are kept.

withdrawn

Only when withdrawn_path is given. One row per withdrawn ID and the ID it was merged into or split to (merged_into_hgnc_id, merged_into_symbol, merged_into_status); an entry without a target has one row with these NA. merged_into_report keeps the original cell. Rows are as written in HGNC's file, including any repeated target.

Details

Both files are tab separated and UTF-8. In the complete set a cell holding several values is pipe separated (a|b) and wrapped in double quotes; the parser strips the wrapper and keeps the pipes. Column names are lower-cased with . and - replaced by _ (pseudogene.org becomes pseudogene_org), and the date_* columns become dates. Every other column stays text as written.

HGNC publishes no release number or date for the current files, so release and release_date are NA unless given (e.g. the month of the download, or the date of an HGNC archive file).

HGNC data are released under CC0; HGNC recommends citing its latest paper, which is recorded in the object's metadata (see get_source_metadata).

See also

Other parsers: cett_nodes_options(), drug_node_options(), parseDrugBank(), parseHPO(), parseHealthCanadaDPD(), parseOnSIDES(), parseOpenFDA(), parseTWOSIDES(), references_node_options()

Examples

hgnc_dir <- system.file("extdata", "hgnc", package = "dbparser")
hgnc <- parseHGNC(file.path(hgnc_dir, "hgnc_complete_set.txt"),
                  withdrawn_path = file.path(hgnc_dir, "withdrawn.txt"),
                  release        = "2026-10",
                  retrieved_at   = "2026-10-16")
#> Parsing HGNC complete set...
#> Parsing HGNC withdrawn entries...
#> Parsed 24 genes and 215 gene names.
hgnc$gene_name[hgnc$gene_name$name == "PD1", ]
#> # A tibble: 3 × 3
#>   hgnc_id    kind         name 
#>   <chr>      <chr>        <chr>
#> 1 HGNC:8760  alias_symbol PD1  
#> 2 HGNC:11138 alias_symbol PD1  
#> 3 HGNC:14681 alias_symbol PD1  
get_source_metadata(hgnc)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 12
#>   metadata_version source source_name          release release_date retrieved_at
#>   <chr>            <chr>  <chr>                <chr>   <date>       <date>      
#> 1 1                hgnc   HUGO Gene Nomenclat… 2026-10 NA           2026-10-16  
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: source_url <chr>, licence <chr>, licence_url <chr>,
#> #   attribution <chr>, files <list>, parser <chr>
